series_break: XLSX-1 -> XLSX-2 is a presentation/OOXML contract break only; it does not by itself change CMS measurement semantics.

workbook.header_filter: provided by the real Excel table; no duplicate worksheet autoFilter and no explicit duplicate table autoFilter element
workbook.summary_location: same worksheet to the right of the table with one blank separator column

must_have: table ref exactly matching row count and column contract

incident_origin: XLSX-1 was observed to trigger Excel repair that removed AutoFilter/Table from xl/tables/table1.xml. XLSX-2 follows the known-good table shape and rejects the former duplicate-filter shape during native readback.
